message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on the fact: From 2009 to June 2013, the chairman Wang gave 165,000 yuan to defendant 常2某 in multiple installments to obtain help in applying for national innovation fund projects. This is bribery (行贿) by Wang (giving money to obtain official assistance). Also could be "受贿" for 常2某, but the fact only mentions Wang giving money. The request: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The fact includes both parties: Wang gave money to 常2某 to get help. So crimes: 行贿 (bribery) for Wang; 受贿 (accepting bribe) for 常2某. Also possibly "非法经营" no. So list both: 行贿;受贿.

We need to output in format: [罪名]行贿;受贿<eoa>.

Check Chinese legal terms: "行贿罪" and "受贿罪". Use just "行贿;受贿". Probably fine.

Thus final.
